_: The passage into Murmuration and out (painting-company row 245): the starlings' light touched at 1 s; the Earth turns its top to the dusk and falls toward Ham Wall, the dusk coming down; the toy's own eye takes over straight above the reed beds, still falling, the flock growing out of the light's likeness; then the eye swings up into the watcher's view of the sunset. The Earth mark at 13 s: all of it backward.
